JOIN fx_rates fx ON i.currency = fx.currency
WHERE i.status = 'paid'
AND i.paid_at >= '2026-07-01' AND i.paid_at < '2026-10-01'
AND a.is_test = false
AND a.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS accounts_with_multiple_subscriptions
FROM subscriptions
WHERE account_id IN (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM subscriptions
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING COUNT(id) > 1
)

SELECT
    s.plan_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS churned_subscriptions
FROM
    subscriptions s
JOIN
    accounts a ON s.account_id = a.id
WHERE
    s.status = 'canceled'
    AND s.cancel_reason IN ('voluntary', 'payment_failed')
    AND s.canceled_at >= '2026-01-01'
    AND s.canceled_at < '2027-01-01'
    AND a.is_test = false
    AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY
    s.plan_tier
ORDER BY
    churned_subscriptions DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_accounts_2024
FROM accounts a
JOIN subscriptions s ON a.id = s.account_id
WHERE a.is_test = false
  AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND a.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
  AND a.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  AND s.status = 'active'

SELECT
    ROUND(
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id)
         FROM accounts a
         JOIN subscriptions s ON a.id = s.account_id
         WHERE a.is_test = false
         AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
         AND a.created_at >= '2025-01-01'
         AND a.created_at < '2025-04-01'
         AND s.status = 'canceled'
         AND s.cancel_reason IN ('voluntary', 'payment_failed')
         AND s.canceled_at < '2026-09-30') * 100.0 /
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id)
         FROM accounts a
         WHERE a.is_test = false
         AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
         AND a.created_at >= '2025-01-01'
         AND a.created_at < '2025-04-01'), 2
    ) AS churn_percentage

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS distinct_users
FROM users u
JOIN accounts a ON u.account_id = a.id
JOIN events e ON u.id = e.user_id
WHERE a.is_test = false
  AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND e.event_type = 'login'
  AND e.occurred_at >= '2026-07-01'
  AND e.occurred_at < '2026-10-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS accounts_with_no_users
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN users u ON a.id = u.account_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE a.is_test = false
  AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND u.id IS NULL

SELECT
    SUM(r.amount_cents::numeric / 100 * fx.usd_per_unit) AS refunded_usd
FROM
    refunds r
JOIN
    invoices i ON r.invoice_id = i.id
JOIN
    accounts a ON i.account_id = a.id
JOIN
    fx_rates fx ON i.currency = fx.currency
WHERE
    a.is_test = false
    AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND i.issued_at >= '2026-04-01'
    AND i.issued_at < '2026-07-01'
    AND r.created_at >= '2026-04-01'
    AND r.created_at < '2026-07-01'

SELECT
    country,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM
    accounts
WHERE
    is_test = false
    AND deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY
    country
ORDER BY
    account_count DESC
